name: Wait times board
description: Estimated waiting times for a clinic, urgent care, pharmacy or service counter: each service with its wait in minutes and an Open, Busy or Closed status in clear colours, a last-updated time, a reassurance notice and a check-in reminder. Staff update a Google Sheet or a Manual table from a phone, or type the list in.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: subtitle
params.label: Subtitle
params.help: One line under the title. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: Optional. Shown beside the title. A white or transparent logo suits the coloured header.

params.name: services
params.label: Services
params.help: One per line: Service | Wait in minutes | Status | Note. Status is Open, Busy or Closed, also in the screen's language (empty = worked out from the wait). Used without a data source.
params.default:
Urgent Care | 45 | Busy | Ground floor · Follow the red line
Walk-in GP | 20 | Open | Ground floor · Rooms 1–6
Pharmacy | 10 | Open | Prescriptions & collection · Counter 3
Blood Tests | 15 | Open | Level 1 · No appointment needed
X-Ray & Imaging | 55 | Busy | Level 1 · East wing
Minor Injuries | 25 | Open | Ground floor · Room 8
Vaccinations | 0 | Open | Level 2 · Flu, COVID-19 & travel
Physiotherapy | | Closed | Appointments only today

params.name: waits
params.label: Wait times data source (optional)
params.help: A Google Sheet, CSV or Manual table with one row per service. When chosen it replaces the services typed above.

params.name: wait_col
params.label: Wait column
params.help: Minutes as a number (25), a range (15-20), or h:mm (1:30). Other text is shown as typed.

params.name: status_col
params.label: Status column
params.help: Open, Busy or Closed. An empty cell is worked out from the wait.

params.name: note_col
params.label: Note column
params.help: Optional small line under the service: where to go, or when it reopens.

params.name: notice
params.label: Notice line
params.default: Times are estimates. Patients are seen by urgency, not arrival — if you feel worse while waiting, tell a member of staff straight away.
params.help: A reassurance or notice along the bottom. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: checkin
params.label: Check-in note
params.help: Highlighted reminder in the footer. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: order
params.label: Order
params.help: When sorting, closed services always go last.

params.name: busy_minutes
params.label: Busy from (minutes)
params.help: A service with no status is shown as Busy when its wait reaches this.

params.name: open_label
params.label: Text: open
params.help: Empty = the built-in word in the screen's language ("Open").

params.name: busy_label
params.label: Text: busy
params.help: Empty = the built-in word in the screen's language ("Busy").

params.name: closed_label
params.label: Text: closed
params.help: Empty = the built-in word in the screen's language ("Closed").

params.name: nowait_label
params.label: Text: no wait
params.help: Shown instead of the time when the wait is 0. Empty = the built-in words in the screen's language ("No wait").

params.name: updated_label
params.label: Text: updated
params.help: Shown before the time; put {time} where the time should go. Empty = the built-in words in the screen's language ("Updated {time}").

params.name: empty_label
params.label: Text when there is no data
params.help: Shown when the data source has no rows yet. Empty = the built-in sentence in the screen's language.

params.name: stale_minutes
params.label: Remind when figures unchanged for (minutes)
params.help: With a data source, the updated time turns amber when no figure has changed for this long (an unchanged sync still counts), as a reminder to staff. 0 turns it off.

params.name: show_meter
params.label: Show a wait bar on each service

params.name: accent
params.label: Accent colour
params.help: The header band and the check-in note.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Timezone
params.help: Leave empty to use the screen's own clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: The words, times and numbers on the screen, for example de or fr-CA. Leave empty for the screen's language.

params.name: page_seconds
params.label: Seconds per page
params.help: Only used when there are too many services to fit on one screen at a readable size.
